source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with misty distant peaks, layered striated cliffs, ravines, pavilions, bridge, scholar figures, bamboo, reeds, rocky banks, water space, and a dense foreground grove. Red seals, inscription, borders, and paper tone are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_mist_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain silhouettes at the upper left behind the main cliffs, including the soft triangular and sloping forms emerging from blank mist.
must_preserve: blank mist gaps between peaks and foreground cliffs

motifs.name: left_ravine_waterfall_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the steep left-side ravine with stacked cliff faces, dark crevice marks, and the narrow descending waterfall or stream channel cutting between rocks.

motifs.name: central_striated_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the broad central cliff wall and ridge system with horizontal sediment-like brush bands, vertical wash streaks, and dark broken ink along the ridge crests.
must_preserve: vertical diluted ink washes down the cliff face
soft pale wash transitions at the cliff base

motifs.name: upper_right_terrace_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-right terraced rock ledge with pale ochre-tinted ground, blocky cliff edges, and the small sparse trees and brush standing on the ledge.
motifs.role: right hillside terrace with sparse trees
must_preserve: pale ochre color accent on the terrace
thin upright tree trunks and twig clusters
dark ink notches under the overhang

motifs.name: left_pavilion_bridge_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the riverside architectural cluster at lower left: two roofed pavilions among trees, the small arched bridge or gate beneath, and the tiny human figures on the veranda.
motifs.role: village pavilion group with bridge and scholar figures
must_preserve: surrounding tree trunks and leaf-dot textures immediately interwoven with the buildings

motifs.name: central_bamboo_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky bank in the center foreground with the cluster of slender bamboo stems rising in front of the cliff, including nearby low rocks and bare twiggy shrubs.
must_preserve: thin bamboo culms and angled leaves
pale wash shadows around the bank

motifs.name: right_reed_cove_pool
motifs.description: Isolate the small right-side water cove below the cliff, with curving shoreline, reeds or grasses, rounded rocks, and dark shaded overhang marks.
motifs.role: water cove with reeds and rocks
must_preserve: curved waterline and faint ripple strokes
dark hatching under the cliff lip
soft blank water space against inked shore

motifs.name: foreground_willow_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large lower-right foreground grove on the raised rocky bank, including leaning willow-like trunks, bamboo thicket, pine-needle foliage, the partially hidden small pavilion roof, and the base rocks.
motifs.role: foreground grove, pavilion, and rocky bank
must_preserve: pale leaning trunks with dark contour accents
dense bamboo leaves and vertical culms
fine pine-needle clusters on upper branches
partly obscured pavilion roof and posts
grass strokes along the bottom edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
